capturedFrom: ERROR_TABLE at the GH-335 base (GH-295 base plus the four GH-335 harness refusal rows)
rows: Check the command name and arguments, then retry the invocation.
The invocation could not be understood.
Inspect the diagnostics stream and report the failure if it persists.
The failure could not be classified.
Wait for the quota window to reset, then retry the operation.
Retry after the provider becomes reachable; consult the announcement and park for the resume time.
Correct or replace the declared credential and retry.
Declare a non-empty provider chain (or select one) and retry.
Correct the named chain entries, ordering, or references and retry.
Declare provider profiles and a preference chain in configuration, then retry; no model is invented when nothing is declared.
No provider profile or preference chain is declared.
Correct the named profile, tier, seat, chain entry, or pacing value and retry; the profile configuration is validated fail-closed.
The provider profile configuration is invalid.
Assign a seat whose declared capability matches the task (for example vision-capable) and retry; the gate reads declared descriptors only.
A profile seat was refused by the hard capability gate.
Wait for a named provider condition to clear or declare another eligible profile, then retry; the decision is parked with reasons.
No provider profile is eligible under the current conditions.
Use a model-environment name that matches the configured allowlist and retry; the record was rejected as a whole.
The env record names a variable outside the allowlist.
Remove the duplicated env-record name and retry; the record was rejected as a whole.
The env record declares a name more than once.
Correct the env-record header, line grammar, name shape, or final line feed and retry; the record was rejected as a whole.
The env record does not conform to the data-v1 grammar.
Reduce the env-record file, line, or record count below the configured limits and retry.
The env record exceeds a configured size limit.
Correct the rejected value and retry the command.
Correct the named configuration source and retry.
Remove or correct the unknown configuration key and retry.
Remove or map the environment name and retry.
An environment configuration name is unmapped.
Correct the value to match the configuration schema and retry.
Use a typed environment override instead and retry.
Move the secret to a supported environment source and retry.
A secret was supplied from a forbidden source.
Move the machine path to a system or user-global source and retry.
A machine path was supplied from a forbidden source.
Correct the reset paths and retry.
Resolve the named warning and retry.
Strict configuration validation rejected a warning.
Supply the credential through its declared environment source and retry.
A required credential was not resolvable from its source.
Inspect the named state store and use the explicit salvage operation as a separate step to truncate a torn tail; never treat the store as empty.
Use a compatible tool version or migrate the store explicitly, then retry.
The state store schema version is not supported.
Verify the writing operation completed and inspect the named store; never substitute defaults.
A state read key-set assertion failed.
Wait for the current writer to release the state fence, then acquire and retry.
The state store is locked by another writer.
Correct operating-system permissions on the named state path and retry.
A state path permission requirement was not met.
Resolve the underlying storage error other than exhaustion and retry; the failed write or rebuild did not land, the ledger remains durable truth, and the index stays disposable.
A state write or index rebuild did not land.
Free storage space on the named state path and retry; the write did not land and the ledger remains at its last valid frame.
The storage backing the state store is exhausted.
Declare the record kind and payload schema at the validated boundary, or use a compatible tool version, then retry.
A record kind or payload schema is not declared at the validated boundary.
Use a state level with an implemented driver; shared levels arrive with later stories.
The requested state level has no implementation.
Correct the document so it conforms to the pm-notes schema (syntax, structure, and value types) and retry.
Add the named required key(s) with a conforming value and retry.
A required pm-notes key is missing.
Add the named missing required phase(s) of the declared variant or correct the declared variant.
A required phase of the declared variant is missing.
pm-notes target only: initialize pm-notes for the named change ref or correct the reference (an absent registry target is a verified-empty pass, C-3).
Restore the named document's readability and encoding, then re-run lint; the document was not evaluated.
A lint target document could not be read or decoded.
Complete the named required phases of the declared variant through the phase command, or correct the declaration, then re-run verify.
The declared variant's required phases are not all completed.
Install or repair the opencode CLI so opencode db path resolves.
The opencode session database is unavailable.
Retry the failed query and verify the session store is readable.
Retry the prune; failed rows remain and are selected again.
A session delete did not land.
Wait until the live window is empty or stop the opencode host, then retry.
A live session is using the database.
Verify the work item ref; a provider not-found means the item does not exist. A payload/parse failure is `provider.payload.invalid`, and access or credential failures keep their own identities.
The closeout target work item was not observed (provider not-found).
Disambiguate the delivery request or local branch for the work item, then retry.
More than one closeout target matched.
Inspect the failed operation evidence and retry; completed operations are persisted and idempotent.
A closeout provider write did not land.
Resolve the named checkout, worktree, protected-ref, or merged-head condition, then retry.
Branch cleanup or checkout restore was refused for safety.
Repair the capsule damage named in the evidence (torn tail, duplicate key, sequence gap, post-close line, or candidate schema failure) and retry; closeout never repairs or truncates the capsule.
The change capsule is damaged and no promotion write landed.
Resolve the named failing gate evidence (lifecycle, CI, push parity, owner gate, or squash preflight) and re-run the gates.
One or more merge gates did not pass.
Restore access to the named gate-evidence source and re-run the gates; the gates were not fully evaluated.
Merge-gate evidence could not be read.
Run the local gate over the declared full suite breadth, or update the declared suite map so the local suite set matches the mirrored CI job, then re-run the gates.
The local gate breadth is narrower than the CI job it mirrors.
Correct the named plan phase and field to match the declared plan schema, then re-run `plan validate`.
The plan document does not conform to the plan schema.
Declare the named path in a phase scope or revert the out-of-scope change, then re-run `plan diff`.
Actual changes fall outside the declared plan scope.
Declare a known ceremony tier or extend the known-tier vocabulary, then re-run `plan validate`.
The plan declares an unknown ceremony tier.
Rewrite the plan as `chg-<ref>-plan.yaml` to make it schema-valid; legacy markdown stays readable during the transition.
The plan is a legacy markdown document, not a schema-valid YAML plan.
Author `chg-<ref>-plan.yaml` (or a legacy `chg-<ref>-plan.md`) for the named change ref, then re-run the command.
No plan artifact exists for the change ref.
Commit or discard the named uncommitted changes, then re-run the lane preflight.
Check out the lane's declared base (or correct the declaration), then re-run the lane preflight.
The lane checkout is not on its declared base.
Restore the declared progress-signal sources, then retry; without them the answer is unknown.
No liveness signal sources are available; the answer is unknown.
Inspect the corroborated stall evidence, then apply the budget-governed restart response for the lane.
The lane is stalled and fully corroborated by the declared progress signals.
Stage or remove the pending material outside the declared scope, or expand the change scope, then retry the commit.
Nothing stageable remains for the requested commit.
Reconcile the repository commitlint configuration with the commit type table (or correct the message), then retry.
Neither the generated message nor the deterministic template satisfied commitlint.
Review the named finding class and path, remove or gitignore the suspected material, then retry; never blind-retry.
The secret scan flagged candidate content or a filename on suspicion.
Restore the deterministic safety scanner and retry; nothing was staged or committed.
The deterministic safety scan could not run.
Retry the completion; the clean abort restored both the ledger and the commit to neither-landed, and a re-run converges.
The atomic phase completion aborted and restored both sides.
Restore access to the named collector source and re-run the board; the board withheld its gates rather than display a partial picture.
The named board collector is unavailable.
Restore access to the named collector source and re-run the board; the board withheld its gates rather than display a partial picture.
The named board collector is unavailable.
Re-run `verify gates` for the current head, then retry the merge; the recorded verification is no longer valid evidence.
The recorded gate verification is stale or voided.
Declare the override with an authorizer authorized for the gate class, then retry; no waiver was recorded.
The declared waiver authorizer is not authorized for the gate class.
Declare an authorized override naming the owner-gate and its authorizer, or resolve the owner-gated state, then retry.
The owner gate failed and no override declaration was supplied.
Resolve the named conflicting paths, re-run `verify gates`, then retry the merge; no force path exists.
Produce a gate verification with `verify gates` and retry; the verification state is absent, torn, or incompatible.
No consumable gate-verification state exists for the change.
Re-run the merge to re-verify the landing; do not blind-retry or manually duplicate the merge.
The landing mutation fired but its landed state is not established.
Clear the named pre-mutation condition and retry; nothing landed and a re-run converges.
The transaction aborted cleanly before any landing mutation.
Produce a deploy trace whose declared steps executed and artifacts exist, then re-run `verify deploy`.
The deploy verdict is unknown because executed-step evidence is absent.
Read the deploy job's execution trace; a status field alone is not evidence. Re-run when the trace is current.
The deploy status field is disqualified as evidence.
Resolve the named failing deploy step and re-run the deployment, then re-run `verify deploy`.
The deploy trace shows a failed step.
Resolve each named failing check using its fix hint, then re-run doctor.
One or more wiring checks failed.
Inspect the harness machine-readable output for the named parse failure, correct the invocation, and retry.
The harness spawn output was not machine-readable.
Read the harness refusal reason, correct the invocation or declared environment, and retry.
The harness refused to start a session.
Declare the named variable in the parent environment or remove it from the allowlist, then retry.
A declared spawn-environment variable is absent.
Use the existing session identity from the original spawn; never resume a fabricated or stale id.
The named session does not exist.
Select a harness that declares the capability or use the declared consumer-side fallback.
The selected harness declares the requested capability as a gap.
Inspect the harness listing output for the named parse failure and correct the invocation.
The harness session-listing output was not machine-readable.
Map the session tree root to a work item before extraction, then re-run the capture.
A session tree root cannot be attributed to a work item.
Repair the malformed session identity in the harness store before extracting telemetry.
A session record carries no valid identity.
Verify the configured harness store location and read permissions, then re-run the closeout capture.
The harness store could not be read for telemetry extraction.
Install or select a harness line inside the declared supported window, then retry the dispatch.
The installed harness version is outside the supported window.
Verify the harness answers its version surface with the declared product line, then retry the dispatch; no version was fabricated.
The installed harness version could not be determined.
Set the harness mode to the delivered default or unset it, then retry the dispatch; no runtime fallback is applied.
The requested harness integration mode is not the available mode.
Declare the named seat's model as provider/model[#variant] within the adapter's declared bound, then retry the dispatch.
A seat's resolved model cannot be expressed on the honoured surface.
Inspect the named evidence position and repair or explicitly salvage the affected artifact, then re-run the retro command; valid entries were preserved.
An evidence entry is malformed and was classified in band.
Inspect the named domain and record positions; do not trust altered evidence. Restore the unaltered artifact or record an explicit salvage before re-running.
A keyed evidence chain failed verification.
Verify the declared collector sources and their windows, then re-run retro collect; a collection that executes must produce collector records.
A collection run executed and produced no collector records.
Write evidence only through the collector seam; the sidecar is collector-owned and the attempted write did not land.
A write outside the collector seam was refused.

Supply the named contract member — a named agent-role or human owner, a verb from add/remove/change/test/deploy, a measurable outcome, a real tracker entry, a due date, a verification artifact, an outcome-verifier window, and a rollback condition — within its declared bound, then re-file; nothing landed.
An action filing is incomplete or violates its contract rule.

Supply the named missing closure member — an explicit decision plus an artifact (done), a reason (deprioritized), a successor (superseded), or in-window verifier evidence (outcome) — or target a plane that is still open; nothing landed.
A closure decision is incomplete or targets an already-closed plane.
Close an open action in the named window on the deprioritized or superseded route, or file into another window, then retry; the window refuses filing at its declared limit and nothing landed.
An improvement window is at its declared WIP limit.
Capture harness telemetry (session-group and capture-outcome records) for the selected work item at closeout, then re-run spend.
No captured harness telemetry exists for the selected work item.
Request a fresh restart budget through the coordinator or operator, then retry the resume.
The delivery's restart budget is exhausted.
Change the harness capability to attach-and-continue, or re-evaluate and accept the prefill re-pay cost, then retry the resume.
The resume path would re-pay prefill and is uneconomical.
Inspect the harness selection and execution environment, then retry the dispatch; no session was created and the attempt stays recorded.
The harness or process failed before a session existed.
Repair the named unreadable ledger, tracker, artifact, or state read and re-run the dispatch; a verdict requires readable truth.
Dispatch truth could not be read, so no verdict was derived.
Remove the named cycle-creating dependency edge (the existing path is named) and retry; nothing was appended.
The dependency edge would close a directed cycle.
Wait for the named holder to release the repository lease or for its heartbeat age to reach the lease TTL, then retry; the live lease was not taken over.
The repository is leased by another holder.
Inspect the named park whose condition cleared without recovery, restore the recovery append path, then retry; reads report the same identity as a report-only finding.
A cleared park stayed active without a recovery record.
Declare the named ref with `queue add` or correct the reference, then retry; no entry was fabricated.
The requested queue entry does not exist.

Resolve the named blocking precondition (an operator hold, readiness, active park, outranking action, or weight class) and retry; repository exclusivity is reported as a lease conflict, never this identity.
A claim precondition was not met.
Supply `--reason` with one of the declared values (landed, abandoned, superseded, reconciled) and retry; nothing was appended.
A queue removal requires a declared reason.
Wait for the named holder's lane to end, then retry; no session, lease record, attempt, or event was created.
The requested ref already has an active lane.
Use one of the declared question types (decision-needed, spec-ambiguity, credential-missing, external-wait) and retry.
The question type is not in the closed blocker vocabulary.
Check the question id with `blockers list` and answer an existing open question.
The named question id does not exist in the store.
Credential questions carry the variable name only; the value comes from the environment.
A credential value was supplied to the blocker channel.
Answer from the question's audience (or an identity the delegation policy allows); the shipped policy refuses coordinator answering an owner-audience question (delegation policy: none).
The answerer may not answer this question's audience.
Use the running daemon or stop it before starting another; the live holder is named with its instance, process, acquisition time, and heartbeat age.
A live daemon instance holds the single-instance lock.
Wait until the lock heartbeat reaches daemon.lock-staleness before requesting a takeover; nothing was appended.
An explicit takeover targeted a live daemon lock.
Start or restart the daemon, or use plain status for a degraded success; the heartbeat age is at or beyond the staleness bound.
Repair or salvage the named state path and retry the start; one-shot commands remain available and the daemon never starts half-reconciled.
Startup reconciliation could not read the durable world.
Use a protocol version in the offered set [1, 0] and reconnect; the frame was refused before any action.
A control frame carried an unsupported protocol version.
Start the daemon or use a state-derived command; only status --live fails closed on an unreachable transport.
The configured control transport cannot be reached.
Retry the subscription later or use the bounded degraded polling mode; subscription capacity was exhausted before any event.
A subscription was refused for capacity.
Use the interactive daemon start on this platform or install a supported unit manually; no supervisor adapter is delivered here.
No supervisor adapter is available on this platform.

Use the running coordinator supervisor or stop it before starting another; a live holder is refused regardless of lease age, and a busy shared state fence may belong to another writer — retry once it releases.
A live coordinator instance holds the state-dir instance lease.
Review the owner escalation question, then restart with `coordinator start --foreground --fresh-budget` after an owner decision or park the coordinator for review.
The coordinator restart budget for the current epoch is exhausted.
Use a process port that declares the alive, kill-with-grace, and start-time identity capabilities; nothing was signalled and no lease record was appended.
The delivered process port declares no required coordinator capability.
Inspect the recorded coordinator process identity and the kill outcome; a failed or identity-mismatched kill sends no further signal and is never reported as success.
The recorded coordinator process tree could not be terminated.
Repair the blocker channel or the shared state fence and retry the tick; no escalation receipt landed, so the exhaustion remains visible as a failed escalation.
The owner exhaustion question could not be published.
Retry the next tick once the session can be woken; no wake record landed, so the one-wake-per-question budget is unspent and the retry cannot duplicate a record.
The coordinator pickup wake could not be delivered.
Repair the named checkout's identity: resolve the named `.git` metadata or restore a readable, internally consistent identity marker, then retry; no path-derived key is ever substituted.
The invoking checkout's identity cannot be read.
Run a state-opening command inside a checkout to repair the host index (the corrupt bytes are preserved as a timestamped sibling), then retry the listing; the failed read changed nothing.
The host index is present but cannot be parsed.
Repair the named project state location or the named identity marker path and retry; the overview answers honestly or fails, and never fabricates a row or a handover state.
A project state location cannot be established or read.

Correct the named configuration document so its declared groups and members are self-consistent (one selector per member, unique non-empty group keys, at least one member per group), then retry; a contradictory document is never rendered as an empty group.
The project configuration document contradicts itself or fails validation.
Request a group key that the configuration document declares, or declare the group first; the requested key is not a configured group.
The requested project group key is not configured.
Run the read inside a checkout whose scope and configuration document can be read, then retry; the group answer is refused rather than silently empty.
The invoking scope or the configuration document cannot be read.
Repair the named checkout's identity: resolve the named `.git` metadata or restore a readable, internally consistent identity marker, then retry; no path-derived key is ever substituted.
The flat record set cannot read the invoking checkout's identity.
Run a state-opening command inside a checkout to repair the host index (the corrupt bytes are preserved as a timestamped sibling), then retry the listing; the failed read changed nothing.
The flat record set's host index is present but cannot be parsed.
Repair the named repository state location or the named identity marker path and retry; the flat listing answers honestly or fails, and never fabricates a row or a handover state.
A repository state location cannot be established or read.
Request one of the six declared topics: "queue", "lanes", "queue.graph", "dispatch.attempt", "phase.state", or "blockers.state".
The requested topic is not part of the declared taxonomy.
The requested events verb is absent or unknown.
The compiled taxonomy declaration failed its own integrity check; repair the declaration and rebuild before serving any page.
The taxonomy declaration failed its integrity check.
Supply the note required by the declaration with its idempotent scopeKey and every required member, then retry; no partial ceremony output is written.
A ceremony note is absent or violates the note contract.
Correct the named declaration field to a declared vocabulary value or within the declared bound, then retry; nothing is registered.
A ceremony declaration violates the declaration contract.
Run the board from a managed checkout or pass a key recorded in the host index ("projects list" or "repos list").
The requested repository key is not in the managed set.
Repair the named host index, repository state location, or required source and retry; the board answers honestly or withholds itself, never with a partial fleet.
A host index, repository state location, or required source cannot be read.
Pass the id of a steering record of this repository to `steer complete`, or run `steer list` to read the recorded ids; no record is written.
The completion target is not a steering record of this repository.
Remove the registered credential value from the note text, ref, or derived origin, then retry; zero bytes are persisted.
A registered credential value was supplied on a steering content path.
Repair the repository's local state store or the unverified append, then retry; nothing is reported landed or completed.
The steering store cannot be read, written, or verified.
